summary.en: After you leave a job and your workplace insurance ends, join National Health Insurance and file the National Pension notice at the ward office within 14 days (to be checked). People who join a new employer's insurance right away, or become a dependant of a family member, follow a different procedure. Check at the counter (to be checked).
